items.arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
items.translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

items.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
items.translation: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allāh is with the patient.

items.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
items.translation: O you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you that you may become righteous.

items.arabic: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَبَيِّنَاتٍ مِّنَ الْهُدَىٰ وَالْفُرْقَانِ
items.translation: The month of Ramaḍān is that in which was revealed the Qur’ān, a guidance for the people and clear proofs of guidance and criterion.

items.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
items.translation: And when My servants ask you concerning Me — indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.translation: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

items.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
items.translation: Allāh does not charge a soul except with that within its capacity.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
items.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

items.arabic: قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبِعُونِي يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
items.translation: Say: If you should love Allāh, then follow me, so Allāh will love you and forgive you your sins. And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

items.arabic: وَسَارِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
items.translation: And hasten to forgiveness from your Lord and a garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for the righteous.

items.arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
items.translation: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are true believers.

items.arabic: وَادْعُوهُ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا ۚ إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِّنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
items.translation: And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allāh is near to the doers of good.

items.arabic: لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَنَا
items.translation: Do not grieve; indeed Allāh is with us.

items.arabic: وَلَا تَيْأَسُوا مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ
items.translation: And despair not of relief from Allāh.

items.arabic: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
items.translation: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured.

items.arabic: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
items.translation: And when your Lord proclaimed: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you in favor.

items.arabic: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.translation: Inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.

items.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّالَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ
items.translation: Indeed, Allāh is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.

items.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
items.translation: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task.

items.arabic: لَا تَخَافَا ۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَا أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
items.translation: Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

items.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَأُولَٰئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
items.translation: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

items.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
items.translation: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allāh is with the doers of good.

items.arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.translation: Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

items.arabic: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
items.translation: And your Lord says: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

items.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
items.translation: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

items.arabic: أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ الْحَقِّ
items.translation: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allāh and what has come down of the truth?

items.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
items.translation: And whoever relies upon Allāh — then He is sufficient for him.

items.arabic: يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ ارْجِعِي إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
items.translation: O reassured soul, return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing to Him.

items.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
items.translation: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, nor has He detested you.

items.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰ
items.translation: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

items.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
items.translation: For indeed, with hardship will be ease. Indeed, with hardship will be ease.

items.arabic: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
items.translation: Indeed, We sent it down during the Night of Decree. And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree? The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

items.arabic: سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ
items.translation: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
Whoever observes the fasts of Ramadan out of sincere faith, hoping for Allah's reward, all his past sins will be forgiven.
Whoever stands in prayer during the nights of Ramadan out of sincere faith, hoping for Allah's reward, all his past sins will be forgiven.
Whoever stands in prayer on the Night of Qadr out of sincere faith, hoping for a reward from Allah, all his previous sins will be forgiven.
When the month of Ramadan begins, the gates of heaven are opened, the gates of Hell are closed, and the devils are chained.
There is a gate in Paradise called Ar-Rayyan. Those who fast will enter through it on the Day of Resurrection, and none but them will enter through it.
There are two joys for the fasting person: one when he breaks his fast, and the other when he meets his Lord, pleased because of his fasting.
He leaves his food, his drink and his desires for My sake. Fasting is for Me, and I will reward it.
The Prophet ﷺ was the most generous of people in doing good, and he was most generous of all in Ramadan, when Jibril met him.
Take suhoor, for in suhoor there is blessing.
The people will remain upon goodness as long as they hasten to break the fast.
Whoever gives a fasting person food to break his fast will have the same reward, without the fasting person's reward being lessened at all.
On the Night of Qadr, say: O Allah, You are Pardoning and Generous; You love to pardon, so pardon me.
Search for the Night of Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadan.
When the last ten nights of Ramadan began, the Prophet ﷺ would tighten his waist-wrap, pray through the night, and wake his family.
I am as My servant thinks I am, and I am with him when he remembers Me. If he comes to Me walking, I go to him running.
Allah stretches out His Hand at night so that the one who sinned by day may repent, and by day so that the one who sinned by night may repent.
Every night, in its last third, our Lord says: Who will call upon Me, that I may answer him? Who will seek My forgiveness, that I may forgive him?
By Allah, I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day.
Every son of Adam sins, and the best of those who sin are those who repent.
The most beloved of deeds to Allah are those done regularly, even if they are small.
Allah is more merciful to His servants than this mother is to her child.
The five prayers, Friday to Friday, and Ramadan to Ramadan wipe away the sins between them, as long as the major sins are avoided.
Every night of Ramadan a caller calls out: O seeker of good, come forward! O seeker of evil, hold back! And Allah frees people from the Fire.
May he be humbled, the one who sees Ramadan come and go before he is forgiven.
Ramadan has come to you, a blessed month. In it is a night better than a thousand months; whoever is deprived of its good is truly deprived.
